name: PROC-THERM-01
text: Compare Sensor A against redundant thermal sensors and verify calibration; continue monitoring the thermal trend.

name: PROC-PWR-01
text: Verify solar generation against load and review the battery discharge trend; prepare a non-critical load-shedding plan for operator review.

name: PROC-SNS-01
text: Compare the noisy channels against redundant sensors, inspect harness/ADC status, and review filtering.

name: PROC-ATT-01
text: Cross-check gyroscope against star tracker and review reaction wheel state.

name: PROC-COMM-01
text: Check antenna pointing and link budget; verify transmitter power.

name: PROC-PL-01
text: Review payload duty cycle and power draw; consider placing the payload in standby.

name: PROC-CAS-01
text: Restore power margin first, then re-evaluate payload and communication loads.
